summary: Implemented the SQLite generated cache adapter behind the file-store boundary. sync refresh rebuilds .boreal/cache/runtime-cache.sqlite from the portable runtime snapshot, doctor reports cache.sqlite freshness when a cache exists, and storage exposes bounded cache row queries for dashboard adapters while FileBorealStore remains the runtime writer.
command: pnpm check; pnpm vitest run tests/runtime/file-store.test.ts -t 'SQLite cache'; pnpm vitest run tests/runtime/cli.test.ts -t 'exports, snapshots, imports'; pnpm test; pnpm console:build; git diff --check; pnpm bwrk sync refresh --session local --json; pnpm bwrk doctor --session local --strict --json
